title: Files

hint.namespace: Pick a defined namespace; blank means "{{default}}"
hint.system: The system this entity is part of.
hint.subcomponentOf: The parent component, when this one is a piece of a larger component.
hint.dependsOn: Components and resources this one needs. When typing instead of picking, name the kind (component: or resource:).
hint.dependencyOf: Components and resources that need this one. When typing instead of picking, name the kind (component: or resource:).
hint.definition: Paste the API document itself (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, …).
hint.parent: The parent group in the org hierarchy.
hint.children: Immediate child groups. Backstage requires this list — empty is fine.
hint.memberOf: Groups this user belongs to. Backstage requires this list — empty is fine.
hint.domain: The domain this system belongs to.
hint.subdomainOf: The parent domain, for nested domains.
hint.sourceUrl: The https address of this file's copy in a GitLab/GitHub repository — enables Sync from repo.

validation.name: Must be 1–63 alphanumeric characters with single - _ . separators
validation.namespace: Must be 1–63 lowercase alphanumeric characters with single dashes
validation.tag: Tag "{{tag}}" must be lowercase [a-z0-9:+#] with single dashes
validation.key: Key must be [prefix/]name — lowercase-domain prefix, alphanumeric name part
validation.reservedKey: This key is written by the catalog server itself
validation.labelValue: Value must be 1–63 alphanumeric characters with single - _ . separators
validation.annotationValueLength: Value must be at most 5000 characters
validation.icon: Icon must be 1–63 alphanumeric characters with single - _ . separators
validation.refEntry: "{{ref}}" is not a valid entity reference
validation.definitionLength: Definition must be at most 100000 characters
validation.profileEmailLength: Email must be at most 254 characters
validation.sourceUrl: Must be an absolute https URL without credentials

validationError: Validation error. Please check the form and try again.
conflictError: An active file with this namespace and name already exists.
refHelp: Each field suggests the stored entities it may point at — picking one inserts its full kind:namespace/name identity. Typed references work too (kind and namespace may usually be omitted); every reference must resolve to a stored entity.

import.title: Import catalog files
import.intro: Paste a catalog-info.yaml (multiple documents separated by ---) or pick a file. Each document imports independently — an existing file is never overwritten.
import.placeholder:
apiVersion: backstage.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: my-service
spec:
  ...
import.urlInvalid: The URL must be a public https address (GitHub/GitLab links are converted automatically).
import.urlFailedStatus: Couldn't fetch the URL ({{status}}). Check that it points at the raw file and is publicly reachable.
import.urlFailedNetwork: Couldn't fetch the URL. Check your connection and try again.
import.tooMany: Too many documents for one import (the limit is 200).
import.failedNetwork: Import failed. Check your connection and try again.
import.sourceHint: Imported files will carry {{url}} as their source reference and start synced.

saveAnyway.title: Save with findings?
saveAnyway.intro: A strict save rejects this document for the findings below. You can save it anyway and fix them later — the Cross-check page tracks every finding until it is resolved.

sync.title: Sync from repo — {{name}}
sync.inSync: DB and repo are in sync
sync.diffLabel: Changes between the DB copy and the repo copy
sync.parseFailed: The repo file is not a valid catalog-info.yaml.
sync.noMatch: The repo file no longer contains this entity.
sync.findingsWarning: The repo version carries {{count}} finding(s) — syncing stores it anyway, and they will show on the Errors report.
sync.overwriteWarning: Syncing overwrites the DB copy with the repo version shown above. Changes made only in the DB will be lost.
